units.pixel_trend_per_decade: NDVI per decade (1/(10 a)), Theil-Sen slope and Sen's 95% interval

units.connected_areas: km2 of 10 m catchment cells in 8-connected pixel groups of at least 4 pixels

sci52_rule: Per SCI-52 (Wilks 2016), pixel-wise significance maps (thresholded p-value or FDR class maps) are never published or drawn. Display rasters and reveal frames paint only the continuous Theil-Sen slope direction and magnitude on a fixed scale; Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (q = 0.05) area shares and per-pixel interval shares are reported in the summary tables with the 2.5% per-direction chance benchmark.

windows.rationale: The three spring windows are those of restrend_long_record. June to September was added on 2026-10-28 before any June to September greenness value was computed, at the founder's request, for the summer grazing season of the high pastures as the founder describes it (June to September); no source in the register verifies that calendar for this valley. In the snow_cover_by_band result the 2001 to 2025 mean snow-covered share of each month from June to September is at most 0.02 in every 500 m band (NDSI 0.2), so this window is nearly snow-free on average; single months can hold more. Composites from 12 July 2025 (A2025193) to the end of 2025 are absent from Planetary Computer, so the 2025 summer season holds 2 of 8 periods and falls below the composite share.

archive_gaps: 7 composite periods absent from Planetary Computer (A2024225, A2025193, A2025209, A2025225, A2025241, A2025257, A2025273); on 2026-10-28 NASA CMR listed 7 of them (held by the NASA archive, which needs an Earthdata login, not used).
limitations: Each pixel's interval is one of thousands. With no change anywhere, about 2.5% of pixels would still show an upward and 2.5% a downward interval at the 95% level, so the shares are shown beside a false discovery rate check (Benjamini and Hochberg 1995, q = 0.05), the control Wilks (2016) recommends when many locations are tested at once, and the map shows the slope only, not which pixels pass.

Neighbouring pixels are not independent: they share weather, snow and sensor effects. A connected area of pixels can arise from one shared cause, and the false discovery rate procedure was proved for independent tests.
Each 250 m MODIS pixel mixes surfaces. Land cover shares use ESA WorldCover 2021, a single 2021 map, applied to every season.

NDVI measures how green the ground looks from above, not forage, palatability or species: in Ait Bouguemez and the Central High Atlas, upper rangelands are dominated by spiny xerophytic vegetation over reduced short grasslands (SCI-19, p. 2), herders report the loss of palatable species (Astragalus armatus, Thymus satureioides) and the spread of unpalatable plants (Thymelaea virgata, Euphorbia nicaeensis) (SCI-03, pp. 7 to 8), and valley-floor apple orchards and irrigated fodder have expanded (SCI-03, pp. 5, 9 to 10; SCI-19, p. 9; SCI-105).

The June to September window spans the transition from late-spring pastoral agdal closure into open summer high-pasture grazing before transhumant flocks leave the valley in September and October (SCI-03, pp. 5 to 6, 12; SCI-19, pp. 2 to 5, Table 1; SCI-96); exact opening dates vary by village assembly and year.
These trends are not adjusted for rainfall; restrend_long_record states how closely the place's greenness follows antecedent rain.

Trend methods can miss real change: in simulations for southern Africa, 30 to 40% degradation was needed before a trend showed under a rainfall-driven increase (Wessels et al. 2012). An interval that includes zero is not evidence of no change.

In the spring windows, upper slopes are snow-covered for part of the window. Composites keep only pixels flagged good or marginal, but earlier or later snowmelt can change spring greenness with no change in the plants.

Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020, from 10:30 to about 9:06 mean local time by December 2025 (NASA): later seasons are seen with a lower sun and longer shadows in mountain terrain, which may shift NDVI without any change on the ground.
